content.tex: You always start the game. In each move, a player now takes \(1, 2\) or 3 sticks from the pile. You always take the number of sticks so that you are sure to win.
In your first move you always take 1 stick so that you are sure to win. The possible number of sticks in the pile at the start form this sequence.
Find the nth term for this sequence.
